facts.fact: RISA's June 2018 document says the Government of Rwanda 'issued' the Smart Rwanda Master Plan (SRMP) in October 2015, with the vision of a knowledge-based society; it names no adopting act or body, so the source's verb is 'issued' only.

systems.system: Rwanda Digital Government Strategy and Governance (Digital Government Platform)

note: The document is RISA's digital government platform strategy (class government, 2018); it carries no fact on its own account. The only national-class statement is the SRMP's issue in October 2015.
